receipts.purpose: Body child section title + synapse devices container
Device count effect uses 60*count and title allowance TH=27
Default launcher stable Synapse image comes from systray media logo_synapse, not the host menu icon

signed_out.note: Source queries .app.list-unstyled (singular) but me renders .apps (plural), so apps height is not added.

height_calculation.account_formula: sum(systrayBody children offsetHeight) + 153; clamp to 400..700; body maxHeight = requested - 153

example_two_device_rows.note: For one Synapse section with exactly two visible normal 60px rows; offsetHeight is integer-rounded. DPR/font/layout observations are not executed.

height_calculation.note: Two launcher items share the fixed 60px apps container; they do not create a 700px window. The account formula applies to systrayBody children, not launcher count.

implementation_boundary.launcher_component: src/shell/tray/launcher.rs accepts observed launchers only; no fixed Synapse fixture.
implementation_boundary.version: Caller must pass audited source version; Cargo package version is not substituted.
